Ava (People Ops): @here Heads-up — we've opened a short midyear amendment window for voluntary benefits (dental/vision/commuter) due to the new vendor switch. If you need to change elections or submit an exception, please do it by next Thursday.
Sam (Benefits): Link to the amendment portal: https://benefits.redwood.com/amendments — use employee ID and last 4 of SSN to verify. :lock:
Lina (Eng): Quick Q — does this affect pre-tax commuter deductions retroactively?
Sam (Benefits): Good Q. Commuter changes will apply prospectively from the next payroll; we can't backdate deductions this cycle. If you need retro adjustments for a special case, file an exception and tag Marta.
Ravi (Hiring): For candidates who start before the deadline, can we enroll them retroactively on first paycheck? We're trying to coordinate offers.
Marta (People Ops Manager): Yes — new hires with start date before the payroll cutoff can be added retroactively. Please ping me with the candidate name + start date. I'll approve exceptions in bulk.
Lina (Eng): Thx. Also filing an exception for a payroll split issue I hit last month.
hr-bot: Reminder: amendment window closes in 7 days (2026-04-30). Submit via portal or reach out to people-ops@redwood.com for manual assistance.
Sam (Benefits): If you're on our old FSA vendor and need balance transfers, submit the transfer request form: https://forms.redwood.com/fsa-transfer — deadline is same day.
Ava (People Ops): Quick process note: approvals typically take 2 business days. If you need same-day help for an imminent payroll cutoff, DM Marta and Sam.
Ravi (Hiring): Noted — I'll include a bullet in the offer packet for new hires this week.
Lina (Eng): :thumbsup: filed my exception, got an auto reply.
Marta (People Ops Manager): I'll triage exceptions tomorrow morning. If anyone in EU or APAC has regional vendor questions, reply here and we'll coordinate local payroll.
Ava (People Ops): Thanks everyone. We'll post a short FAQ in the handbook page and a follow-up thread with common exception reasons.
